label: conj:weinberg-angle-categorical
title: Weinberg angle $\theta_W$ as Hecke-eigenvalue ratio on the EW Hoefsmit projectors
html:
Let R be the categorical coefficient ring with generic q \in R. Under the Hoefsmit cell-content identification of the EW triplet inside \mathrm{End}_R(V^{\otimes 6}), W \leftrightarrow \sigma_1^4, Z \leftrightarrow \sigma_3^6, H \leftrightarrow \sigma_5^8. The Standard Model Weinberg angle \theta_W is the categorical scalar in R given by

  \cos\theta_W
  \;:=\;
  \frac{\mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_W^{+} \cdot \sigma_1^4\bigr)}
       {\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_W^{+} \cdot \sigma_1^4\bigr)^2
              + \mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_B^{+} \cdot \sigma_5^8\bigr)^2}},
  \sin\theta_W
  \;:=\;
  \frac{\mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_B^{+} \cdot \sigma_5^8\bigr)}
       {\sqrt{\mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_W^{+} \cdot \sigma_1^4\bigr)^2
              + \mathrm{tr}_M\bigl(e_B^{+} \cdot \sigma_5^8\bigr)^2}},

where e_W^{+}, e_B^{+} are the Hoefsmit-projector idempotents on the symmetric channels of the W and B slots respectively. The B slot is understood pre-EWSB before W^3/B mixing.

At n = 6, the Hoefsmit identification assigns \sigma_1^4 to W, \sigma_3^6 to Z, and \sigma_5^8 to H. Pre-EWSB, the Hoefsmit slot \sigma_5^8 corresponds to the pre-mixing B generator. The rotation by \theta_W sends (W^3, B) \mapsto (Z, \gamma). This rotation acts as a specific change-of-basis in the Hoefsmit projector decomposition.

Evaluating \mathrm{tr}_M(e_W^{+} \cdot \sigma_1^4) / \mathrm{tr}_M(e_B^{+} \cdot \sigma_5^8) at the pure pattern yields \cot\theta_W \stackrel{?}{=} q^{-4} \approx 0.6588. This fails to match the 1.823 CODATA target. A correct categorical derivation must apply the non-uniform pure-pattern multiplicities, incorporate the categorical-linking operation, and potentially weight the trace by the Higgs vacuum expectation value. Each of these repairs acts inside the carrier, which is where a repair must act: \mathrm{tr}_M decomposes as \sum_\lambda y_\lambda \chi_\lambda and the Schur–Weyl row cap sets y_\lambda = 0 for every \ell(\lambda) > N, so at the fibre dimension N = 2 the definition above is blind to the blocks with three or more rows by construction. A construction that reaches the CODATA value by reading the spectrum of such a block instead is not a competing evaluation of \cos\theta_W as defined here; it is a reading of a module the carrier does not contain. Expressing \theta_W as a ratio of categorical scalars remains structurally consistent. Proving this conjecture supplies \sin\theta_W, \cos\theta_W \in R as categorical scalars, closing the Weinberg-angle gap.

This conjecture gates the Coulomb term. Neither the braid nor any invariant pair coupling produces a Coulomb pair term between nucleon blocks (the Coulomb-charge definition). The invariant coupling with the right Cartan shape is the unbroken neutral exchange g^2\,T_3T_3' + g'^2\,(Y/2)(Y'/2), and it splits identically as e^2\,QQ' + g_Z^2\,(T_3 - s^2Q)(T_3' - s^2Q') with Q = T_3 + Y/2, s^2 = g'^2/(g^2+g'^2) and e^2 = g^2 s^2 (the flavour-charge remark). Here \tan\theta_W = g'/g, so s^2 = \sin^2\theta_W is exactly the scalar this conjecture would supply, and e^2 \neq 0 requires \sin\theta_W \neq 0. The conjecture is necessary for the Coulomb term but not sufficient. On nucleon blocks the exchange with a fraction \lambda of the second term kept has the Coulomb form if and only if \lambda = 0, whatever the value of s^2, so a mass scale for the Z that removes the second term at nuclear distance is a separate input; no such scale is derived in this framework. Until both are supplied, the Coulomb energy used in the binding Lagrangian is an import.
